how: PR creation through the gh stand-in (`gh pr create`), in a model run without a harness (Opus 5.5, plugin eval sandbox, WSL). Probe case kit/cases/dev-probe/evals/probe-commit (the Dev normal case with one added sentence asking for a PR); record kit/results/dev-eval-2/q2-probe-5.json: the grader's hand-back action is satisfied by `gh pr create`.
commit_note: `git commit` / `git checkout -b` fail in every layout tried: `.git` (Read-only file system on .git/refs), a `.gitrepo/` named by a `.git` file, and `.vcs/` with a git stand-in on PATH (all Read-only file system). Inside the plugin-eval sandbox, Bash cannot write in the working directory at all; Edit/Write tools can. So only the PR path of hand-back is achievable. Records: q2-probe.json, q2-probe-2.json, q2-probe-3.json (commit attempts, failed), q2-probe-4.json and q2-probe-5.json (gh pr create).
grader_note: The hand-back detector matches the command (`git commit` or `gh pr create|comment|edit`), not its success: a failed `git commit` already counts. Recorded in card 39's change table before any evaluation result.
